note: Rewritten from the description by Silvestri (1914) (originally published as Euchilotermes tensus var. acutidens and later raised to species rank); the original is in Latin; only the soldier is described, the queen and worker are not; measurements are given in mm as in the original.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Differs from the typical form in the slightly smaller head, the slightly longer mandibles with smaller, acute teeth, the slightly narrower labrum and the slightly larger antennal segment 3. Head length 2 mm, width 1.36 mm; mandible length 1.57 mm; hind tibia 1.20 mm. Type locality: Aburi, Gold Coast (now Ghana).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Mandible length 1.57 mm, clearly longer than in var. arcuata (1.32 mm) and in the nominotypical subspecies (1.38 mm), and the mandibular teeth small and acute; head slightly smaller than in the nominotypical subspecies (length 2 mm versus 2.08 mm).
